title: Numerical Engine-Derived Execution Trace Schema
description: Authoritative contract for numerical simulation execution traces generated dynamically by the simulation engine during cold-start or execution runs. Captures per-step parameter draws, lagged edge deliveries, state transitions, stock-flow integrations, and deterministic replay hashes.

schema_version.description: SemVer of this execution trace schema (e.g. 2.0.0 or 2.1.0).

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this simulation run.

model_id.description: Identifier of the compiled simulation model.

formula_version.description: Mathematical engine propagation formula semantics applied.

generated_by.description: Component or engine generating this trace (e.g. 'aleph.engine.numerical').

generation_mode.description: Provenance mode of the trace. Only 'engine_derived' satisfies cold-start automated execution requirements.

execution_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of simulation start.

seed.description: Pseudorandom generator seed used for drawing sampled strengths/parameters.

parameters_hash.description: Digest of compiled model configuration, baseline parameters, and intervention vectors.

total_ticks.description: Total discrete simulation time horizons/ticks modeled.

total_samples.description: Total Monte Carlo trajectories or sample iterations executed.

invalid_mass.description: Proportion of trajectories that failed convergence or exceeded domain bounds. Must not be silently normalized away.

steps.description: Ordered sequence of discrete causal hops, signal emissions, arrivals, and node integrations.

final_state_vector.description: Final integrated values for all observable nodes at termination tick.

replay_hash.description: Final canonical hash of the chronological step chain, guaranteeing bit-exact deterministic replay.

step.description: Monotonically increasing 1-based step counter across the run.

emission_tick.description: Tick at which the source node produced this causal impulse.

delivery_tick.description: Tick at which the causal impulse arrives at the target node (delivery_tick = emission_tick + lag).

source_node_id.description: Source node identifier emitting the signal.

node_id.description: Target node identifier receiving the signal or undergoing state update.

drawn_strength.description: Specific numerical strength sampled by RNG or resolved deterministically.

sampled_parameters.description: Explicit values of all stochastic parameters drawn for this transition.

source_state.description: Numerical value of source node at emission_tick.

target_state_before.description: Numerical value of target node prior to applying this step effect.

target_state_after.description: Numerical value of target node after applying this step effect.

intervention_type.description: Intervention semantics applied at this node/tick.

stock_flow_integrations.description: Explicit numerical integration record for dynamic stock/flow variables.

evidence_refs.description: Cryptographic evidence anchors backing this edge transition.

hash_chain.description: Running SHA-256 hash chaining previous step's hash_chain with current step canonical bytes.
